fusions.name: Cast Wide
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted line that deals 7 water damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drawn Tight
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh across the cone ahead, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Strung Awning
fusions.desc: Strings a mesh wall 7 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds. You restore 12 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Catch Basin
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
